definition: Maintaining an accurate representation of a changing situation across many steps, and across 4 sources a capability the archive evaluates as distinct from step-wise reasoning. Its benchmarks: a chess testbed where 13 models play each other and none beats a human-amateur-level engine while some lose to random play, and a multi-turn reasoning benchmark. Its mechanism is probed directly by the scratchpad work, which edits the internal representation of a written state while holding the printed text fixed and asks whether the next step follows the transition rule applied to the edited value -- a causal test with a single correct answer, whose move-specific selectivity gaps of +0.57 and +0.68 show the model combining the edited state with the supplied move. One theoretical source proves length generalisation for a procedure over states, which is the formal counterpart.

evidence.note: A competitive chess testbed where 13 models play each other, and no model beats a human-amateur-level engine while some lose to random play.
evidence.title: ChessArena: A Chess Testbed for Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models

evidence.note: A fully automated multi-turn reasoning benchmark of 40 tasks and 3600 instances requiring interaction with an environment, on which frontier reasoning models fall short.
evidence.title: MTR-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Turn Reasoning Evaluation

evidence.note: Edits the internal representation of a written scratchpad state while holding the printed text fixed, and asks whether the next step follows the transition rule applied to the edited value — turning 'does the model use its scratchpad?' into a causal test with a single correct answer.
evidence.title: Do Models Read What They Write? Causal Registers in Scratchpad Reasoning

evidence.note: Gives the first optimization guarantee that gradient descent trains constant-depth transformers to solve NC1-complete problems with chain of thought, and shows the algebraic structure of the task decides how far the learned reasoning extrapolates.
evidence.title: Transformers Provably Learn Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Length Generalization

name: state tracking
